_comment: 英文覆盖层：按索引对齐 foods/scenes/unis 的中文条目（本文件数组顺序必须与 zh 文件一致）。覆盖 desc/history 叙述字段；名称用各条目已有的 en 字段。
history: Xining, ancient Qingtang city, guarded the Silk Road's southern line and the Tang-Tibet road for two millennia. Tsongkhapa, founder of the Gelug school, was born here; Kumbum Monastery's butter sculptures, murals and embroidery are the 'three arts' famed across Tibet. Average summer temperature 18°C — one of China's best summer retreats.
importance: Capital of Qinghai · Gateway of the Plateau
foods: Plateau Tibetan lamb, tender and fresh.
Thick niangpi noodles with fragrant chili oil.
Sweet oat ferment — a lightly tipsy summer cooler.
Old yogurt with a golden skin on top.
Air-dried yak jerky, better with every chew.
Fu brick tea with salt and milk — the herder's way.
A copper pot of mixed goodies for warm winters.
scenes: One of the six Gelug monasteries — home of the three arts.
China's largest saltwater lake ringed by rapeseed flowers.
One of the four great mosques of the Northwest.
Riyue Pass — where Princess Wencheng crossed to Tibet.
Huangyuan — an old tea-horse trade city.
